title: "I'm fully who I am": Towards Centering Transgender and Non-Binary Voices to Measure Biases in Open Language Generation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus was on measuring gender non-affirmation harms, specifically misgendering and harmful responses to gender disclosure, for transgender and non-binary (TGNB) individuals in open language generation.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on gender identity and biases against transgender and non-binary individuals.
